ranked.headline: Pretrained and generative models address sparse data in genomics and single-cell studies
ranked.summary: Limited observed data in single-cell, genomic and regulatory settings motivates simulation, augmentation and foundation-model pretraining.

ranked.headline: Read-based tools for classifying microbes and strains directly from sequencing reads
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend read-level classification to nanopore 16S, strain-resolved metagenomics, and ITS amplicons with refinement and benchmarking layers.

ranked.headline: Inferring unobserved temporal dynamics from static single-cell and imaging data
ranked.summary: Destructive snapshots and cross-sectional images limit direct observation of time, driving methods that infer dynamics from static inputs.

ranked.headline: Sequence models increasingly resolve gene regulation by cell type, tissue and condition
ranked.summary: Deep learning and statistical models now predict context-dependent splicing, enhancer-promoter contacts and expression from sequence and epigenomic data.

ranked.headline: Protein language models repurposed for promoter, mRNA, and operon sequence prediction
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and cross-modal transfer now test whether protein-trained and nucleotide foundation models generalize across genomic sequence tasks.

ranked.headline: Long-read and imputation methods extend variant calling to SVs and metagenomes
ranked.summary: Assembly-derived SV panels enable SNP-based imputation of structural variants for trait GWAS across 2,624 UK Biobank traits.

ranked.headline: Analyst-defined features and gates recover cell populations in omics and imaging data
ranked.summary: Interactive and unsupervised tools increasingly extract cell-type and lineage structure from single-cell and imaging measurements without relying solely on…

ranked.headline: Scalable pipelines reveal methodological bias in comparative genomic inference
ranked.summary: Expanding genome collections now demand scalable annotation pipelines whose outputs require explicit assessment of methodological bias.

ranked.headline: Matrix factorization unifies batch correction and imputation in proteomics data
ranked.summary: Single-framework methods now combine batch correction with missing-value imputation for bulk and single-cell mass spectrometry proteomics.

ranked.headline: Automated tools extend molecular dynamics setup to dihedrals, cyclic peptides and DNA
ranked.summary: Recent preprint and publications automate parametrization and input generation for coarse-grained, all-atom, and nonstandard biomolecular models.

ranked.headline: Interpretable, uncertainty-aware models for biomedical survival and omics prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications embed reliability, rule-level readability, and missing-block handling directly into survival and classification models.

ranked.headline: Pretrained structural representations reused for binding, docking and design tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend pretrained geometric and language-model representations to affinity, docking, interaction discovery and surface-conditioned design.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict enzyme, degrader, and protein interaction partners and interfaces
ranked.summary: Recent work adds curated degrader benchmarks, enzyme-reaction retrieval, and interface-level E3-substrate atlases to interaction prediction.

ranked.headline: Computational ranking of variants and sgRNAs ahead of clinical and experimental decisions
ranked.summary: Recent work weights sequence, structure, clinical text, and cohort prevalence to decide which variants and guides merit expert or experimental follow-up.

ranked.headline: Inferring cell-state transitions and causal drivers from static single-cell measurements
ranked.summary: Single-cell and spatial snapshots lack time resolution, so new frameworks recover transition routes and causal drivers from static data.

ranked.headline: Single-cell and locus-resolved transcriptomics resolve aging and senescence cell states
ranked.summary: Isoform, locus and regulatory-layer profiling now resolves age- and senescence-linked transcriptional states beyond gene-level expression.

ranked.headline: LLM agents automate code generation and method selection across biological data analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and two published papers report LLM agents that generate, select, and validate analysis code for biological research workflows.

ranked.headline: Inference under model and normalization uncertainty in metabolic and compositional data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints add explicit model-uncertainty averaging and normalization-invariant ranking to flux and omics inference.

ranked.headline: Leakage-aware benchmarks reassess predictive tools for molecular and protein design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers expose leakage and inconsistent evaluation in prediction tools, motivating standardized reference benchmarks.

ranked.headline: Mutations reshape conformational landscapes governing channel and translocase function
ranked.summary: Recent GaMD and MD studies link single mutations to altered ATP hydrolysis coupling, channel gating, and open-state ensembles.

ranked.headline: Polymer simulations separate confinement from specific interactions in chromosome folding
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published model extend physical simulations to bacterial chromosomes and nucleosome-resolution eukaryotic chromatin domains.

ranked.headline: Learned models and simulations map protein conformational dynamics and binding pathways
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple structural proteomics, graph neural networks and Markov state models to study disordered-protein and complex flexibility.

ranked.headline: Structure-based modeling of ligand binding across protein and RNA targets
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs ensemble-based free energy calculations with bias-controlled datasets for RNA and protein ligand binding prediction.

ranked.headline: Splicing fidelity and isoform quantification across bulk, single-cell, and long-read…
ranked.summary: Large calibrated splicing datasets and splice-aware design expose missplicing failure modes that transcript-level quantification must resolve.

ranked.headline: Open pipelines automate literature retrieval, fungal gene calling and protein annotation
ranked.summary: Recent releases pair scalable retrieval, deep-learning gene prediction and containerised annotation with programmatic outputs.

ranked.headline: Open platforms link metabolomic, lipidomic, and genome-scale metabolic model analyses
ranked.summary: Expanding public metabolome, lipidome, and transcriptome resources increasingly require interactive tools for integrative analysis and reconstruction…

ranked.headline: Transformer and flow models advance de novo peptide sequencing and open PTM discovery
ranked.summary: Learned models now decode peptide identity from MS/MS spectra, extend to open PTM discovery, and probe retention mechanisms with interpretability tools.

ranked.headline: Data-driven inference of spiking neuron parameters and temporal dynamics
ranked.summary: Mechanistic spiking simulations are now paired with learned and optimised inference to recover neuron and network parameters from data.

ranked.headline: Priors on graph structure, from layer design to explanations and edge statistics
ranked.summary: Biological graph methods are moving beyond generic node embeddings to encode priors through layers, explanations, and edge statistics.

ranked.headline: Omics inference methods now report uncertainty and benchmark performance explicitly
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a 2026 publication pair omics methods with explicit uncertainty estimates or standardized benchmark metrics.

ranked.headline: Coupling histological morphology with spatial expression at subcellular resolution
ranked.summary: Spot-level spatial transcriptomics is being refined toward single-cell and nuclear resolution by pairing expression with H&E and nuclear morphology.

ranked.headline: Viral and cellular proteomes show constrained elemental and ecological composition
ranked.summary: Deep-time and ecological analyses now link proteome composition, phage receptor motifs, and viral niche partitioning across cellular and viral life.

ranked.headline: Structure-based models predict druggable and cryptic pockets and ADMET liabilities
ranked.summary: Structure-grounded models are now applied to pocket druggability, cryptic allostery, and anti-target ADMET liabilities.

ranked.headline: Bayesian models infer latent infection and infectiousness from indirect measurements
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published model recover infection states from PCR-only kinetics, raw titration data, and 1991 Gambian trachoma data.

ranked.headline: Computational scoring prioritizes viral k-mers, protein stability, and DMS substitutions
ranked.summary: Mega-scale stability measurements and a targeted DMS classifier expand data-driven prioritization of variants and sequence features.

ranked.headline: MD methods resolve Fe2+ site preference in frataxin and speed long-range electrostatics
ranked.summary: Free-energy landscapes, electrostatic efficiency, and force-field consistency are being addressed jointly within molecular dynamics frameworks.
